description.en: Generate a source-backed equity research report with live fundamentals, market data, valuation context, news, risks, and QVeris call trace.
description.zh: 用实时基本面、行情、估值语境、新闻、风险和 QVeris 调用链生成有来源依据的股票深度研究报告。

overview.en: Use this skill when an agent needs to turn a ticker or company name into a professional equity research draft. It routes through QVeris to discover, inspect, and call financial statement, quote, company profile, peer, filings, and news capabilities before composing the report.
overview.zh: 当 Agent 需要把股票代码或公司名称转成专业股票研究草稿时使用。它通过 QVeris 发现、检查并调用财务报表、行情、公司资料、可比公司、公告和新闻能力，再生成报告。

description.en: Write a full research draft for one public company.
description.zh: 为一家上市公司生成完整研究草稿。

prompt.en: Analyze NVDA using QVeris. Build an equity research report with business summary, latest price action, fundamentals, valuation context, peer comparison, recent filings or news, upside/downside risks, QVeris capabilities used, paid Call count, and what evidence is still missing.
prompt.zh: 使用 QVeris 分析 NVDA。生成股票研究报告，包含业务摘要、近期价格变化、基本面、估值语境、可比公司、近期公告或新闻、上行/下行风险、使用的 QVeris 能力、付费 Call 次数和缺失证据。

description.en: Compare one company against peers before writing the conclusion.
description.zh: 先比较可比公司，再写结论。

prompt.en: Use QVeris to compare AMD, NVDA, and INTC across revenue growth, margin trend, valuation, market reaction, news catalysts, and key risks. Rank the evidence quality before giving a view.
prompt.zh: 用 QVeris 对比 AMD、NVDA、INTC 的收入增长、利润率趋势、估值、市场反应、新闻催化和主要风险。先排序证据质量，再给观点。

prompt.en: Use QVeris to challenge the bull case for AAPL. Pull financials, recent news, filings, and peer valuation, then produce the strongest bear-case memo and the evidence that would disprove it.
prompt.zh: 用 QVeris 挑战 AAPL 的多头观点。调用财务、近期新闻、公告和可比估值，生成最强空头 memo，并说明哪些证据会推翻它。

description.en: Turn structured financial data into callable agent capabilities.
description.zh: 把结构化金融数据变成 Agent 可调用能力。

description.en: Add market data coverage for global research and screening workflows.
description.zh: 为全球研究和筛选工作流补充市场数据覆盖。

description.en: A practical workflow for source-backed A-share monitoring.
description.zh: 面向 A 股监控和来源证据研究的实用工作流。

title.zh: 寻找股票研究数据能力

purpose.en: Find quotes, financial statements, company profiles, peers, filings, transcripts, and news capabilities.
purpose.zh: 寻找行情、财务报表、公司资料、可比公司、公告、电话会和新闻能力。

qveris_api.sample_query: stock financial statements valuation peers news API

purpose.en: Check ticker coverage, fields, history length, latency, success rate, and billing_rule before paid calls.
purpose.zh: 付费调用前检查股票覆盖、字段、历史长度、延迟、成功率和 billing_rule。

purpose.en: Execute selected sources and compose them into a research report with citations and a QVeris call trace.
purpose.zh: 执行选定来源，并把结果组织成带引用和 QVeris 调用链的研究报告。

summary.en: This workflow usually needs 6-18 paid Calls after free Discover and Inspect preflight. Cost depends on providers, ticker count, and time window.
summary.zh: 该工作流通常在免费 Discover 和 Inspect 预检后需要 6-18 次付费 Call。费用取决于供应商、股票数量和时间窗口。

note.en: Ask for explicit approval before paid Calls. Inspect billing_rule for every selected capability and reduce scope if the estimate is too high.
note.zh: 付费 Call 前必须获得明确确认。检查每个选定能力的 billing_rule；如果预计成本过高，先缩小范围。

description.en: Set ticker, market, peer set, time window, required sections, and whether the output is initiation, update, or challenge memo.
description.zh: 设定股票、市场、可比公司、时间窗口、所需章节，以及输出是首次覆盖、更新还是反证 memo。

description.en: Use QVeris Discover and Inspect before paid calls, then show estimated usage.
description.zh: 先用 QVeris Discover 和 Inspect，再展示预计使用量。

description.en: Call only the data needed for the report and separate facts from interpretation.
description.zh: 只调用报告所需数据，并区分事实和判断。

description.en: Return the report, evidence gaps, used capabilities, paid Call count, and not-investment-advice disclaimer.
description.zh: 返回报告、证据缺口、使用能力、付费 Call 次数和非投资建议说明。
